releaseNotes: v1.9.9: Proxy egress, SSE error detection & build integrity — provider-injected SSE error events are now detected inline and fail the turn, so a dead downstream behind OpenRouter stops reading as a served success and the sick connection is locked out of combo rotation (#151); proxy pool rotation for OpenCode actually routes through its pools, with per-provider round-robin cursors, usage egress showing the pool name, and deletion of a pool serving rotation traffic now returning 409 (#149); proxy egress rejections are recorded in Usage & Analytics as requestDetails 502 rows, with a marshalled (no longer string-concatenated) error body (#152); SQLite PRAGMAs now apply per pooled connection via the driver DSN, so all 4 connections get busy_timeout and foreign_keys instead of 1 (#139); /debug/pprof/* sits behind RequireAdminAuth when PPROF_ENABLED=true (#126); http.Server gains ReadHeaderTimeout/IdleTimeout/MaxHeaderBytes, closing the Slowloris hole (#132); relay deploy endpoints moved under /api/proxy-pools/*-deploy behind dashboard auth, fixing 401 on every Deploy button, and Deno polling no longer reports 'deployment timed out' for an already-failed build (#140); make web-build fingerprints every frontend input, so pulling main stops embedding a stale SPA (#149 build fix); proxy pool Health Check gains a permanent Test All, real-time latency badges, dual Google/Cloudflare probing, and status filters with Disable/Delete Failed reporting only server-confirmed results (#128); Usage Details tab shows the real provider name for custom providers (#153); live upstream tests are opt-in via 9ROUTER_LIVE_TESTS=1 / make test-live, keeping CI hermetic; plus flaky-test fixes in internal/fetchgate and internal/app database handle reset (#144).
